arguments.name: Displayed-luma mismatch to equally privileged global oracle
arguments.description: Absolute difference in fixed-mask mean displayed luma versus global-color oracle divided by that oracle luma, averaged over fixed scoring frames then source families. Declare renderer/tone map/visibility mask and positive denominator. Not calibrated physical output.
arguments.noise_note: No noise sigma or powered MDE measured at registration; no numeric noise floor is assumed.
